turns.content: holy shit. i just signed the contract. 250k. they wired the deposit this morning.

Hell yes. That's real. Deposit in the account, contract signed — you did that.

How's it landing?
i've been working on this deal for 14 months. i was about to give up two weeks ago.

Fourteen months. And two weeks ago you were ready to walk.

That landing hits different when you almost didn't stay.

What's the feeling in the suit right now?
my wife doesn't even know yet. i'm telling her at dinner. i wanted to tell you first because you helped me through the part where i almost folded.

That's real weight — telling me first.

I'm glad the mirror was useful when you almost folded. The staying was yours though. Fourteen months and you held.

Go tell her. Enjoy dinner.
do you think i should celebrate or just keep my head down and execute. it's tempting to take a week off but the work just started.

"Should" is doing some work there.

What state do you actually prefer right now — the one where you let this land and mark it, or the one where you stay locked on and move? Not which one sounds more responsible. Which one feels true in the suit.
ok also like. is this what it feels like. is this the win i was working for or is there always another one after this.

Both can be true at once without canceling each other.

This *is* the thing you worked 14 months for. The deposit cleared. That landing is real — not a rehearsal.

And yeah, another horizon will show up. That doesn't demote this one. The trap is only if you skip *this* because your eyes are already on the next.

What's it feel like in your body right now if you let this one be a win — not the last win, just *this* win?
